Initial release of the Camping skill.

- Provides nearby campsite discovery, camping gear list comparisons, outdoor eco-friendly guidelines, and real-time weather alerts.
- Supports filtering by transportation mode, travel preferences, and visa/COVID policy requirements.
- Offers up-to-date ticket/flight info, travel tips, weather warnings, and local spending references.
- Rapid response to transport hub, weather, and inventory data changes.
- Includes travel safety advice and reminders for peak seasons.
